national.title: How to Change Name After Marriage Across All Indian Documents (2026)
national.summary: Step-by-step master checklist for legally changing your name or surname after marriage across Indian identity documents. Verified sequence covering marriage certificate, Gazette notification, Aadhaar, PAN, and passport updates.

steps.title: Secure Registered Marriage Certificate as Legal Base
steps.description: Obtain your official marriage certificate, which serves as primary legal evidence of marriage and surname change.
steps.calloutText: A legally registered marriage certificate is accepted by UIDAI and Passport Seva for simple surname changes.

steps.title: Execute Name Change Affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper
steps.description: Draft an affidavit stating maiden name, married name, husband's name, and wedding date on ₹100 stamp paper.
steps.calloutText: The affidavit should be signed by both husband and wife before a first-class judicial magistrate or notary public.

steps.title: Publish Name Change Declaration in Daily Newspaper
steps.description: Place a public notice declaring your change of maiden surname to married surname in one prominent newspaper.

steps.title: Apply for Gazette of India Notification
steps.description: Submit application to the Controller of Publications with ₹1,100 fee to publish formal notice in Part IV of The Gazette.
steps.officialLinkLabel: Open The Gazette of India Portal
steps.calloutText: Gazette notification is compulsory for government servants and when completely changing first name along with surname.

steps.title: Update Married Name in Aadhaar First
steps.description: Visit an Aadhaar Kendra with your marriage certificate to update your surname and receive updated e-Aadhaar in 7-15 days.

steps.title: Update PAN Card with Updated Aadhaar Details
steps.description: Submit PAN correction Form CSF online using paperless Aadhaar e-KYC. Fee is ₹107 for physical card reprint.
steps.where: Income Tax Authorized PAN Portal (Form CSF)

steps.title: Re-issue Passport with New Surname and Spouse Endorsement
steps.description: Apply for passport re-issue under 'Change in Personal Particulars' to print your married surname and spouse's name.

steps.title: Update Bank Accounts, Voter ID, and Property Records
steps.description: Submit updated Aadhaar and PAN copies to update bank KYC, credit cards, investments, and electoral roll.
steps.where: Bank Branch, EPIC Portal & Revenue Office

rejectionReasons.title: Updating Bank or Passport Before Updating Aadhaar and PAN
rejectionReasons.description: Financial institutions and Passport Seva verify live data against UIDAI and Income Tax databases automatically.
rejectionReasons.solution: Update Aadhaar first, then PAN card, before approaching banks or passport authorities.

rejectionReasons.title: Spelling Mismatch Between Marriage Certificate and New Documents
rejectionReasons.description: If your chosen married surname differs from the husband's surname recorded in the marriage certificate, scrutiny fails.
rejectionReasons.solution: Ensure the married surname matches the husband's family name or execute a formal Gazette notification.

rejectionReasons.title: Unnotarized Name Change Affidavit on Plain Paper
rejectionReasons.description: Affidavits written on plain paper or lacking notary public verification stamps are rejected across all departments.
rejectionReasons.solution: Execute the affidavit on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper attested by a registered notary public.

rejectionReasons.title: Uploading Classified Ad Slip Instead of Full Newspaper Page
rejectionReasons.description: The Gazette Department strictly rejects receipts or cut-out clippings without the newspaper masthead and publication date.
rejectionReasons.solution: Submit the complete unaltered page of the daily newspaper showing header and date.

rejectionReasons.title: Changing First Name Without Formal Gazette Notification
rejectionReasons.description: While surname change alone is permitted with a marriage certificate, altering a first name mandates full Gazette notice.
rejectionReasons.solution: Publish a formal notification in The Gazette of India before requesting first name change in passport.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Unregistered Marriage Proof (Temple Receipt Only)
rejectionReasons.description: Informal temple receipts or unofficial marriage photos are not recognized as legal proof for surname change.
rejectionReasons.solution: Register the marriage with the Sub-Registrar to obtain a certified statutory marriage certificate.

faqItems.question: Is a woman legally required to change her surname after marriage?
faqItems.answer: No. Retaining your maiden surname after marriage is completely legal under Indian law, and changing it is entirely optional.

faqItems.question: Is a Gazette notification mandatory for changing surname after marriage?
faqItems.answer: No. For a simple surname change to husband's family name, a registered marriage certificate is accepted by most authorities.

faqItems.question: In what order should I update my official documents after marriage?
faqItems.answer: Update Aadhaar first, then PAN card, followed by Passport, bank accounts, voter ID, and driving licence.

faqItems.question: Can I add my spouse's name to my passport without changing my surname?
faqItems.answer: Yes. You can endorse your husband's name as spouse in your passport while retaining your maiden surname.

faqItems.question: How long does the entire post-marriage document update process take?
faqItems.answer: Updating Aadhaar and PAN takes 15 to 25 days, while passport re-issue takes an additional 7 to 14 days.

faqItems.question: What is the fee to update name and surname across all documents?
faqItems.answer: Aadhaar update costs ₹50, PAN correction costs ₹107, and passport re-issue costs ₹1,500 under standard service.

faqItems.question: Can I update my PAN card name before updating my Aadhaar card?
faqItems.answer: No. Income Tax rules require the updated name to match Aadhaar records before a PAN correction can be validated.

faqItems.question: What documents do banks require to change a married woman's name?
faqItems.answer: Banks require an updated Aadhaar card, updated PAN card, marriage certificate, and a formal name change request form.
